name: novafood
description: NovaFood: a full-stack, real-time food ordering platform with a playful 3D experience.
author: Aradhya Dixit

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @novafood/api" "npm run dev -w @novafood/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @novafood/api && npm run build -w @novafood/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @novafood/shared && npm run test -w @novafood/api && npm run test -w @novafood/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @novafood/shared && npm run typecheck -w @novafood/api && npm run typecheck -w @novafood/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
